Alice (PM): quick async check - need an exec-ready snapshot for Q2 OKR milestone M-3 by EOD Friday. what shipped vs slipped? owners?
Brian (Eng): shipped: model-routing canary + autoscale policy rolled (PR #4382). latency numbers look good. slipped: dedupe-cache work delayed ~2w due to infra churn.
Carla (Eng): code-review ping: blocking PRs -> #4420 (kv-cache), #4441 (batching telemetry). @brian can you review #4420? it's small.
Brian (Eng): @Carla on it, will review today. noted about dedupe-cache - blocker is GPU infra scheduling conflict.
Frank (SRE): infra update: we had a maintenance on 03/12 that pushed some Dedicated cluster reboots; scheduling for next slot is Tue 03/18. that impacts any infra-heavy rollout this week.
Carla (Eng): partial workaround in place: added fallback route -> `model-variant-lite` when GPU pool full. config snippet:
```yaml
routing:
  fallback: model-variant-lite
```
Alice (PM): OK, list owners for next actions and ETA please.
Brian (Eng): owners: dedupe-cache -> Brian (Eng) + Frank (SRE) ; kv-cache PR -> Carla ; telemetry batching -> Dina (Observability)
Carla (Eng): ETA kv-cache PR merge: tomorrow EOD if review done. telemetry batching needs infra quota - depends on Frank.
Frank (SRE): I can free a slot Wed morning; if Brian queues the heavy tests by then we can run validation Wed-Thu.
